mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_engagement_stats ( course_id, course_title, teacher_id, total_enrollments, active_learners, completed_count, completion_rate ) VALUES ( #{courseId}, #{courseTitle}, #{teacherId}, #{enrollmentDelta}, #{enrollmentDelta}, #{completedDelta}, CASE WHEN #{enrollmentDelta} > 0 THEN ROUND((#{completedDelta} * 100.0) / #{enrollmentDelta}, 2) ELSE 0.00 END ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE course_title = VALUES(course_title), total_enrollments = total_enrollments + VALUES(total_enrollments), active_learners = active_learners + VALUES(active_learners), completed_count = completed_count + VALUES(completed_count), completion_rate = CASE WHEN (total_enrollments + VALUES(total_enrollments)) > 0 THEN ROUND(((completed_count + VALUES(completed_count)) * 100.0) / (total_enrollments + VALUES(total_enrollments)), 2) ELSE 0.00 END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
